parent_objective: implement and run exactly 15 matched-budget profile training jobs
blocked_by: M2229 freezes execution policy and routes actual training to M2230
supersedes: ad hoc manual train_ppo execution for matched-budget profile comparison

public_gates: M2230 may implement a focused execution adapter and run exactly the 15 M2227 profile/seed configs
M2230 must remap only output paths to the M2230 execution root
M2230 must preserve the frozen profiles, seeds, budgets, and actor input contract
M2230 must fail closed on missing configs, contract violations, nonzero train_ppo return codes, missing checkpoints, missing eval summaries, or non-finite selected metrics
M2230 must write run rows, profile aggregates, summary, command matrix, and run_state
M2230 must not rank controller families, select a winner, promote a checkpoint, claim paper-level evidence, claim finite-window-vs-GRU evidence, or claim level3 self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs matched-budget public training seeds for L0/L1/L2/L3 profiles to produce comparable checkpoint quality evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public training data only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim before result audit
stop_condition: stop if any train_ppo job fails
stop if any contract or budget guard fails
stop after the 15 fixed jobs and route to result audit
fallback_plan: if runner implementation fails, route to implementation repair
if one or more profile/seed runs fail, record partial rows and route to failure audit
if all runs complete, route to result audit before any comparison or measured execution

admission_evidence: M2224 and M2225 provide pretrain capability evidence that the current recurrent profile evidence is weak and that matched-budget training is required before comparison
M2230 is the admitted posttrain capability evidence collection step; posttrain interpretation remains blocked until the following result audit
M2227 and M2228 provide exact/proof gates for profile count, seed policy, budget signature, actor contract, and guardrail-clean config materialization
M2229 provides rollback or repair protection by requiring fail-closed execution, partial-row recording, output-root remap discipline, and a result-audit route before any ranking claim
blocked_shortcuts: do not tune profiles after seeing results
do not rank profiles before result audit
do not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID
allowed_updates: M2230 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: all 15 profile/seed train_ppo runs complete or failures are recorded
run rows and profile aggregates are written
quality-floor pass/fail counts are recorded without ranking claims

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2230 trains public matched-budget profiles but does not run causal history interventions.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2230; L3 reset-control and finite-window comparisons remain blocked until result audit and later measured execution.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Three public training seeds per profile with 32 public eval episodes per checkpoint.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If L3 remains weak or finite windows look stronger, record it and route to audit without weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: matched-budget public training completion and readiness-floor status
no architecture ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim before audit

must_synthesize_if: M2230 shows all profiles below readiness floors

hypothesis: The M2227 matched-budget profile configs can be executed as 15 fixed train_ppo jobs with clean contract checks and finite post-training metrics, producing auditable public checkpoint-quality evidence.
success_criteria: no promotion, ranking, paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claim is made
failure_criteria: any expected checkpoint or eval summary is missing
results are framed as architecture ranking or self-identification evidence before audit
decision_rule: M2230 passes if the focused adapter executes exactly the 15 fixed profile/seed jobs, records failures if any, and keeps all ranking and paper-level claims blocked.
